title: For the top 10 instance display names with the highest variance in instance
question: For the top 10 instance display names with the highest variance in instance memory (MB) among instances in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state, show each display name and availability zone along with its average memory, memory variance, total vCPUs, and the (completed) migration-count range/variance/standard-deviation metrics for that same display name and availability zone. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT display_name, availability_zone, memory_mb, vcpus, uuid
  FROM instances
  WHERE vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded'
),
inst_agg AS (
  SELECT display_name, availability_zone,
         AVG(memory_mb) AS avg_memory,
         VAR_SAMP(memory_mb) AS memory_variance,
         SUM(vcpus) AS total_vcpus
  FROM base
  GROUP BY display_name, availability_zone
),
mig AS (
  SELECT b.display_name, b.availability_zone, b.uuid, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count
  FROM base b
  JOIN migrations m ON m.instance_uuid = b.uuid AND m.status = 'completed'
  GROUP BY b.display_name, b.availability_zone, b.uuid
),
mig_agg AS (
  SELECT display_name, availability_zone,
         MAX(migration_count) - MIN(migration_count) AS migration_count_range,
         VAR_SAMP(migration_count) AS migration_count_variance,
         STDDEV_SAMP(migration_count) AS migration_count_stddev
  FROM mig
  GROUP BY display_name, availability_zone
)
SELECT i.display_name,
       i.availability_zone,
       i.avg_memory,
       i.memory_variance,
       i.total_vcpus,
       ma.migration_count_range,
       ma.migration_count_variance,
       ma.migration_count_stddev
FROM inst_agg i
LEFT JOIN mig_agg ma
  ON ma.display_name = i.display_name AND ma.availability_zone = i.availability_zone
ORDER BY i.memory_variance DESC
LIMIT 10

  SELECT 
    i.display_name,
    i.availability_zone,
    AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory,
    VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance,
    SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus

),

  SELECT 
    i.display_name,
    i.availability_zone,
    i.uuid,

  WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded'
    AND m.status = 'completed'
  GROUP BY i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.uuid
),

  SELECT

    availability_zone,

    VARIANCE(migration_count) AS migration_count_variance,
    STDDEV(migration_count) AS migration_count_stddev

)

DEST_HOST, INSTANCE_UUID, instance_display_name, instance_vm_state, instance_memory_mb, instance_vcpus, metadata_key, metadata_value, migration_memory_remaining, window_column AS WITH StateRollup AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, MAX(ie.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_extra_id_next_2 FROM `instance_extra` AS ie inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT sr.vm_state, sr.power_state, sr.total_instances, mc.coefficient_of_variation, mc.completed_migration_count FROM StateRollup AS sr LEFT JOIN MigrationCV AS mc ON mc.vm_state = sr.vm_state ORDER BY CASE WHEN sr.vm_state = 'GRAND TOTAL' THEN 2 WHEN sr.power_state = 'SUBTOTAL' THEN historical_programs.sql_template: WITH inner_cte AS (WITH mem_stats AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), meta_vcpu AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM `instance_extra` AS ie JOIN `instances` AS i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone), top10_by_variance AS (SELECT display_name, memory_mb_variance, memory_mb_stddev FROM mem_stats ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT t.display_name, t.memory_mb_variance, t.memory_mb_stddev, mv.instance_uuid, mv.availability_zone, mv.metadata_entry_count, mv.total_vcpus FROM top10_by_variance AS t JOIN meta_vcpu AS mv ON t.display_name = mv.display_name ORDER BY t.memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT c.display_name, c.memory_mb_variance, c.memory_mb_stddev, c.instance_uuid, c.availability_zone, c.metadata_entry_count, c.total_vcpus, CASE WHEN i.config_drive IN ('True', 'true', '1', 1) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_config_drive FROM inner_cte AS c JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid ORDER BY c.memory_mb_variance DESC

WITH prime_variability AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(c.updated_at - i.created_at) / NULLIF(AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS e ON e.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS c ON c.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(c.updated_at - inner_cte JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON i2.vm_state = inner_cte.vm_state JOIN `migrations` AS m2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE m2.status = 'completed' AND i2.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT sr.vm_state, sr.power_state, sr.total_instances, mc.coefficient_of_variation, mc.completed_migration_count FROM StateRollup AS sr LEFT JOIN MigrationCV AS mc ON mc.vm_state = sr.vm_state ORDER BY CASE WHEN sr.vm_state = 'GRAND TOTAL' THEN 2 WHEN sr.power_state = 'SUBTOTAL' THEN WITH base AS (
  SELECT display_name, availability_zone, memory_mb, vcpus, uuid
  FROM instances
  WHERE vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded'
),
inst_agg AS (
  SELECT display_name, availability_zone,
         AVG(memory_mb) AS avg_memory,
         VAR_SAMP(memory_mb) AS memory_variance,
         SUM(vcpus) AS total_vcpus
  FROM base
  GROUP BY display_name, availability_zone
),
mig AS (
  SELECT b.display_name, b.availability_zone, b.uuid, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count
  FROM base b
  JOIN migrations m ON m.instance_uuid = b.uuid AND m.status = 'completed'
  GROUP BY b.display_name, b.availability_zone, b.uuid
),
mig_agg AS (
  SELECT display_name, availability_zone,
         MAX(migration_count) - MIN(migration_count) AS migration_count_range,
         VAR_SAMP(migration_count) AS migration_count_variance,
         STDDEV_SAMP(migration_count) AS migration_count_stddev
  FROM mig
  GROUP BY display_name, availability_zone
)
